title.en: Shabaqo’s royal image survives in fragments
title.zh: 沙巴卡的王室形象以残件留存

alt.en: A damaged green-glazed statuette preserves folded legs and the lower part of a kneeling body beside an upright fragment.
alt.zh: 破损的绿釉小像保留跪姿身体的下半部与折叠双腿，旁有竖立残部。

caption.en: Fragmentary statuette of King Shabaqo, about 705–690 BCE; glazed steatite and paint, Met 1990.10.
caption.zh: 沙巴卡王残缺小像，约前705—690年；施釉滑石及颜料，大都会1990.10。

interpretation.en: The Met identifies this fragment as a kneeling image of Shabaqo, a king of the Kushite Twenty-fifth Dynasty. Its damaged condition is part of the surviving evidence, not a reconstruction of his appearance.
interpretation.zh: 大都会将此残件识别为库施第二十五王朝君主沙巴卡的跪像。破损状态是存世证据的一部分，并非对其容貌的复原。

title.en: A Mixtec vessel takes the wind deity’s form
title.zh: 米斯特克容器采用风神形象

alt.en: A pale stone vessel on small supports has a projecting beaked face and incised patterns across its body.
alt.zh: 浅色石制容器立于小支脚上，突出喙状面部，器身刻有纹样。

caption.en: Ehecatl wind-deity vessel by Mixtec (Ñuu Savi) artists, tenth–thirteenth centuries; Met 1979.206.948.
caption.zh: 米斯特克（Ñuu Savi）匠人制作的埃埃卡特尔风神容器，十至十三世纪；大都会1979.206.948。

interpretation.en: The catalog identifies a deity vessel, not a portrait of a named ruler. Carved stone gives another medium for visual religious expression beside painted books.
interpretation.zh: 馆录将其识别为神祇形象容器，并非具名君主肖像。石雕展示了彩绘书册之外另一种宗教视觉表达媒介。

items.creator: Mixtec (Ñuu Savi) artists
items.credit: The Michael C. Rockefeller Memorial Collection, Bequest of Nelson A. Rockefeller, 1979

note.zh: 官方单件页面标注图像为公共领域；所存API记录确认isPublicDomain=true。

alt.en: A narrow black-and-white photograph shows a crowned standing bronze figure with several arms and a draped lower garment.
alt.zh: 黑白窄幅照片中，一尊戴冠多臂青铜像站立，下身披覆衣裙。

caption.en: Standing deity, possibly Vishnu, Sumatra, eighth–ninth century, catalogued as Srivijaya period; Met 65.146.
caption.zh: 站立神像，可能为毗湿奴，苏门答腊，八至九世纪，馆录归为室利佛逝时期；大都会65.146。

interpretation.en: The uncertain Vishnu identification broadens the material view beyond an exclusively Buddhist image of the period. The object does not establish a royal commission or a particular temple.
interpretation.zh: “可能为毗湿奴”的识别，使该时期的实物视野超出单一佛教图景。此器物不能确认某次王室委托或特定寺庙。

title.en: An elephant becomes a Lý-period ewer
title.zh: 李朝陶匠将大象塑成水注

alt.en: A glazed ceramic elephant with raised trunk has dark incised decoration and an opening on its back.
alt.zh: 釉陶大象扬起鼻子，器表有深色刻划装饰，背上留有开口。

caption.en: Elephant-shaped ewer, Vietnam, eleventh–twelfth century, Lý dynasty; glazed pottery with incised and inlaid decoration, Met 2007.261.
caption.zh: 象形水注，越南，十一至十二世纪，李朝；施釉陶器，刻划及镶嵌装饰，大都会2007.261。

interpretation.en: The ewer makes ceramic shaping and surface decoration visible. Its catalogue does not establish use in the royal palace or excavation at Thăng Long.
interpretation.zh: 水注使陶器塑形与表面装饰技艺可见。馆录并未确认它曾用于王宫或出土于升龙。
